description: Styles by app (ai/cleanup_styles.rs), for `yap.exe eval --styles`: dictations as speech-to-text writes them, each for a kind of app and one of its tones, with checks on the cleaned text. Each is cleaned twice: as before styles (the main cleanup alone, as every app got it until 24 Oct 2026) and with its kind's style, through the dictation's own code (`cleanup_styles::resolve` for a stand-in app of the kind, then `cleanup_styles::clean`). The order mixes the kinds, as dictations into different apps would. `quick`: the cases a cloud model's run keeps (`--styles-quick`). Checks: `has` (every one, any case), `has_any` (one of each list), `not` (none of them, as whole words, any case), `exact`, `starts_with` (case as written), `lines_min` (lines with text), `lowercase` (no capital outside `keep`), `no_final_period`, `empty`, `max_words`. People and places are fictional.
